lessons.claim: There are two routes to non-dimensionalization and they are ranked -- (1) non-dimensionalizing the governing differential equation: being ratios of the equation's terms it is unique and interpretable (2) Buckingham: the book explicitly says it is 'for the situation where the governing equation is not known' and the combination is not unique. ★ Our L3 (bdbot/nondim.py) knows Langevin/Smoluchowski so it is (1), and our design of defining and checking a dimensionless number as 'the ratio of two ledger entries' is the same logic as (1) -- retreating to the method of extracting pi from a variable list loses the interpretability
